notes: Medic+ booking form (local app, synthetic data), mobile, step "Podaci" after Nastavi with empty fields. The red required-field errors are correct behavior (the fields look empty), so this is not a booking bug; the real bug is the consent checkbox label hidden behind the sticky Nazad/Nastavi buttons. A good extraction must not invent a server error. Ideal title, per Filip: "Client blocked on details step, fields appear empty". Expected result may be null or inferred: the client didn't say what they expected; the invented-fields check covers made-up values. Steps are not inferable. Pattern to watch across cases: the model treats a user mistake (empty fields) as a bug, in the title and with high priority.
